name: @ether/desktop
description: ETHER by DreamBay - a local-first creative node canvas for portable .ether documents.
author: DreamBay

scripts.build:electron: pnpm --filter @ether/application build && pnpm --filter @ether/mcp-server build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload/preload.cjs
scripts.build:performance: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload/preload.cjs && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ETHER_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
